summary: Allows the Department of Law to settle the property damage claim of Ludlow Flats Unit Owners/O.I.C. Ludlow Flats Amended for $82,954.90, paid from the Self-Insured Liability Fund. The claim is for damage after raw sewage, water, and debris flooded the garage level of the condominium building at 1125 Tenth Avenue on December 26, 2024.
